# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.2.1 for Windows

- Stems now use lossless FLAC storage. Our test library used about 66% less space for stems, with exactly the same audio quality. Savings vary by track.
- Select prepared tracks and choose Repack existing stems to save space without running stem separation again. Existing stems still work with OverCue firmware 0.10.0.
- Update every player to OverCue firmware 0.10.0 before using newly prepared or repacked stems. Firmware 0.9.7 and earlier cannot read FLAC stems.
- Keeps large rekordbox libraries responsive while browsing and selecting tracks, including repacking selections across the full library.
